steps.sql: DECLARE @j nvarchar(max)=N'{"n":1}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING int) AS n;
DECLARE @j varchar(max)='{"n":1}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING int) AS n;
DECLARE @j int=1; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING int) AS n;
DECLARE @j json=NULL; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING int) AS n;
CREATE TABLE t(j json,n AS JSON_VALUE(j,'$.n' RETURNING int)); INSERT t(j) VALUES(N'{"n":12}'); SELECT n FROM t; SELECT definition FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N't');

CREATE TABLE t(j json,a AS JSON_QUERY(j,'$.a[*]' WITH ARRAY WRAPPER)); INSERT t(j) VALUES(N'{"a":[1,2]}'); SELECT a FROM t; SELECT definition FROM sys.computed_columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N't');
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING int) AS n INTO t; SELECT n FROM t; SELECT system_type_id,max_length,is_nullable FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID(N't');
DECLARE @j nvarchar(max)=N'{"a":[1,2]}'; SELECT JSON_QUERY(@j,'$.a[*]' WITH ARRAY WRAPPER) AS a FOR JSON PATH;
